=== BASH AND TOOL NOTES, RE-CONFIRMED AT CYCLE 126 ===
Bash refuses paths outside /home/runner/work/SPIRAL/SPIRAL (INCLUDING /tmp); refuses 'python3 script.py' AND 'python3 -c' (SO YOU CANNOT RUN scripts/validate_state.py -- hand-check the gates with jq, and SAY SO rather than implying a validator run); refuses 'cp'; refuses PROCESS SUBSTITUTION '<(...)'; refuses jq's '--arg'/'--rawfile'/'--slurpfile', 'sed -i', 'for' loops, and ANY CHAINING WITH '&&' OR ';'. ONE command per Bash call. A single leading 'cd <dir>; <cmd>' IS accepted, as are 'rm -f', 'mv', redirection, 'ls', 'wc', 'head -c', 'tail', 'sed -n <range>p', 'grep -n', 'grep -c', 'grep -o' and PIPES. 'git show <rev>:<path> | jq ...' WORKS AND IS THE CHEAPEST WAY TO READ A PAST STATE. For multi-file searching use the Grep TOOL.
[227]: a jq program with an OBJECT CONSTRUCTOR (brace, comma, brace) is USUALLY rejected as shell brace expansion -- build an ARRAY OF LABELLED STRINGS and join it. SQUARE BRACKETS ARE SAFE.
